description: Produce promo trailers from real gameplay of a Godot 4 game: a beat-synced 16:9 1080p60 trailer, a native 9:16 vertical cut, a looping GIF and posters, rendered with Movie Maker from bot playthroughs in the game's own fonts and art, cut on the bar grid of a procedural cue, and reproducible from a marketing/ directory the game never depends on. Use for any trailer, teaser, gameplay or promo video, marketing or social media video, devlog clip or gameplay GIF of a Godot game, in GameGen projects or standalone.
